notes: Corrected Scotty 2 Hotty to the authoritative ScottyTooHottie.gac Superstar page (61 HP).
Added exact callable ability handlers for Kevin Nash, Trish Stratus, Bubba Ray Dudley, D-Von Dudley, The Hurricane, and Scotty 2 Hotty.
Existing exact passive abilities are now identified as active rather than shown as merely preserved.

superstars.name: STONE COLD STEVE AUSTIN
superstars.ability: You draw a page when you play a Damage special with a move that connects.

superstars.name: THE ROCK
superstars.ability:
Special: The People
Draw two pages. Use this ability once per game.

superstars.name: TRIPLE H
superstars.ability:
Special: Be The Game
Name a page. That page is drawn from your Playbook and put into your hand. Use this ability once per game.

superstars.name: THE UNDERTAKER
superstars.ability: The first five times your opponent counters one of your moves that cost 6 or more to play, you draw a page.

superstars.name: KANE
superstars.ability: Kane takes -1 damage from Impact moves and ignores the first Stun he receives.

superstars.name: KURT ANGLE
superstars.ability: At the start of turns 1 and 20, Kurt Angle gets +1 Knowledge.

superstars.name: CHRIS JERICHO
superstars.ability:
Special: Jerichoholics
Lose 1 Attitude and choose a Momentum from your playbook. That page is drawn. Use this ability three times per match and only if you have at least 1 Attitude.

superstars.name: CHRIS BENOIT
superstars.ability: Each time an opponent's body part takes 5 damage, you draw a page. (This happens when that body part takes 14 damage, 21 damage, and so on.)

superstars.name: BIG SHOW
superstars.ability: The first 3 times you Autocounter without playing a Special that turn, you draw 3 pages.

superstars.name: BOOKER T
superstars.ability:
Special: Can You Dig It?

Choose a move page in hand. That page is ditched and you draw a page. This ability works nine times per match.

superstars.name: EDGE
superstars.ability: Whenever you attempt a pin after turn 10, you gain 1 Attitude (including pin attempts from moves or specials that pin).

superstars.name: CHRISTIAN
superstars.ability:
"Un-Americans" Member
If you don't have Warnings, your opponent can't play "Plead to the Referee" or "Good Officiating!"
Special: On Your Own
The number of Warnings you have is reset to 0. Use twice per match.

superstars.name: EDDIE GUERRERO
superstars.ability: When you end a turn without playing a move (or keeping a Hold applied), you lose up to 4 Attitude Momentum.  When your opponent does this after turn 5, you draw a page.

superstars.name: ROB VAN DAM
superstars.ability:
Special: R-V-D
Use once per match after turn 10, while in control, and before you play a move. Draw 1 page and gain 1 Attitude for each move in a row you've connected with. You can't play more pages this turn.

superstars.name: RIC FLAIR
superstars.ability: If your opponent plays a Heel page or receives a Warning, you get 3 Attitude. If your opponent has Vince McMahon in play, your moves do +2 damage.

superstars.name: HOLLYWOOD HULK HOGAN
superstars.ability:
nWo Superstar. You may play only one nWo page.
Special: "The Icon"
Use only while in control when you have a Special in hand, up to five times per match. The least expensive Special in your hand is ditched and you gain 1 Knowledge.

superstars.name: KEVIN NASH
superstars.ability:
Scott Hall Trademark

At the end of each fifth turn of the match, you gain 1 Attitude.
Special: The Referee is removed from the game.
(Heel page: cannot be played if you have played a Face page.)

superstars.name: JEFF HARDY
superstars.ability:
Member of Team Xtreme

Jeff Hardy can Autocounter for -1 page.

When Jeff Hardy plays a Drop move you draw a page.

superstars.name: MATT HARDY
superstars.ability:
Member of Team Xtreme

Not including the first two moves in each move string, Matt Hardy gets Crowd Support when your opponent hits you with a move.

superstars.name: LITA
superstars.ability:
Member of Team Xtreme, Diva Superstar

You get "Crowd Support" when you play a Face page. When you play "Crowd Support" your opponent loses 1 Attitude.

superstars.name: TRISH STRATUS
superstars.ability: Special: You cant play moves this turn. There is a 50% chance that you ditch 2 pages. Otherwise, you gain control at the end of the turn, your move next turn can't be countered by moves, and you can't use this ability again. Use this ability only when your opponent is in control and isn't playing or applying a Hold.

superstars.name: BUBBA RAY DUDLEY
superstars.ability:
You do +1 damage with Takedown moves.
Special: "Those Damn Dudleyz!"
Choose an Event or Unique page from your playbook. You draw that page. Use this ability twice per match.

superstars.name: D-VON DUDLEY
superstars.ability:
Special: "D-Von! Get the..."
Choose a Weapon, Ringside Special, "Set Up A Table" or "Set Up A Ladder" from your playbook. You draw that page. Use this ability twice per match.

superstars.name: SPIKE DUDLEY
superstars.ability:
Spike Dudley can't play Strength moves offensively against non-Cruiserweights.

Whenever you are hit with a move that does 4 or more damage, you draw a page.

superstars.name: BRADSHAW
superstars.ability:
Hardcore Superstar

When you connect with an Impact move that costs 5 or more, your opponent ditches a random special from hand (except Crowd Support) or Gameplan from play.

superstars.name: GOLDUST
superstars.ability:
Special: "The Bizarre One"

Ditch your entire hand. You draw ten pages. Use this ability only once, and only after turn 20.

superstars.name: LANCE STORM
superstars.ability:
Member of The Un-Americans

Special: "Serious"
If your next move this turn is countered, draw a page. Use this ability 9 times per match and only when in control.

superstars.name: RIKISHI
superstars.ability:
Special: "Sultan of Squat"
Your opponent loses 1 Momentum and a Strength or Strike Momentum page is placed in your hand. This ability works twice a match.

superstars.name: SCOTTY 2 HOTTY
superstars.ability:
Special: Turn it up!
Choose a Gameplan Special from your playbook; you draw it. Use only if you have connected with 2 moves in a row, once per move string and four times per match.

superstars.name: TAJIRI
superstars.ability: Tajiri's Strike moves do +4 damage if you connected with a non-Strike move last turn.

superstars.name: TAZZ
superstars.ability:
Special: Change The Mood

Ditch a random page and name an In Close move in your Playbook. That move is drawn to your hand. This works 2 times per match.

superstars.name: TEST
superstars.ability:
"Un-Americans" Member

Your Impact moves do +1 damage for each other Impact move you have connected with. This count resets when you lose control.

superstars.name: THE HURRICANE
superstars.ability:
Special: Super Powers

Choose a Move in your opponent's hand. You steal it and gain enough momentum to play it until end of turn (even breaking your limits). Use once per match, after turn 5.

superstars.name: WILLIAM REGAL
superstars.ability:
Special: "Besmirched"

Once per game, choose "Distract the Referee" or "Plead to the Ref" and that page is played.
(The play restrictions of those pages are ignored.)

superstars.name: X-PAC
superstars.ability:
When in control, your Impact moves do up to +3 damage.
Special: Martial Arts Pro
Choose a Leg Extended move in your Playbook. That move is drawn to your hand. Use once per match.
